baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: I know i know, another Tower map, but listen, i tried my best to do something diferent and unique with an very brief idea i have on my mind so there here is! Neon Tower! So far i think this is my hardest map to date so i’ll hope you enjoy a good challenge to play . This map present some tranzit Sprinters, custom zombie models (my first time trying custom zombie models lol) , a little easter egg at the final and a lot of dificulty , so good luck and i recommend you to bring a friend to play it! With this map i tried for the first time to script something to give it a different final to it and to learn how to do some new stuff Maybe im being very optimistic about the difficulty of this one and is more easy than i think, but way i learned a lot doing this and trying new stuff to add to my future maps, any feedback will be very welcome! Honestly i don’t know what more to say. . . So enjoy! This map features: – Custom Weapons from BO1, BO2, MW3 and BO3. – Bo1, Bo2 and Bo3 Perks – BO2 Nuke – 3 hits system – Tron Zombies – Bo2 HUD (kinda) – Power up customs (Random Perk Power Up, Pack and Punch Power Up, Money Power Up) – Custom Player Model and Hands – Tranzit Sprinters – Hug Fix and Bo1 knife – Buyable ending – Custom Camo – Hitmarkers – Added recoil and balance to weapon movement – Elemental Staffs – Shootable ending – PanzerSoldat – Brutus from MOTD – New Vision File For The Map – Moving Platforms Credits: – Shippuden1592 (Power up Money, Brutus Scripts and Models, Elemental Sta
